def generate_palindrome(base_string):
    return base_string + base_string[::-1]

# Generate a base string (you can replace this with any string)

# Ensure the generated palindrome is at least 255 characters long
palindrome = generate_palindrome(base_string)

    additional_chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[: (255 - len(palindrome))]
    palindrome += additional_chars
